about_the_game:
3D Snakes and Ladders is a visually enhanced digital version of the classic board game, set in a dynamic 3D environment. Players move across a 3D board filled with animated snakes and ladders. The game supports a single-player mode where the player competes against multiple AI opponents.

Key Features:

-Single Player: Play against 1–3 AI-controlled players.

-AI Opponents: Multiple AI difficulty levels for varied challenge.

-6 Different characters available for the player in the game. (1 character is available in Demo version)

-Animated Snakes: Snakes slither and animate when a player lands on them.

-Climbable Ladders: Characters visually climb ladders in real-time.

-3D Environment: Fully rendered board with zoom, rotate, and pan camera controls. 12 different levels available for the player. Difficulty increases after each level. (2 levels are available in Demo version)

-Many More.
